description: This source file contains a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' designed to transform raw aggregate cost records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent and a secondary dimension (environment or cost_category), filling in missing categories with zero values to ensure consistent bar grouping.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, grouping by agent and a secondary dimension, with options for sorting and labeling.
